# Famous Equations

Euler's identity: eⁱπ + 1 = 0

The quadratic formula: x = (−b ± √(b²−4ac)) / 2a

Newton's second law: F = ma

The Pythagorean theorem: a² + b² = c²

Einstein's field equations: Gμν + Λgμν = 8πTμν

Schrödinger equation: ⁱℏ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ

The normal distribution: f(x) = (1/√(2πσ²)) · e⁻⁽ˣ⁻μ⁾²⁄²σ²

Gauss's law: ∮ E · dA = Q/ε₀

Fourier transform: f̂(ω) = ∫₋∞⁺∞ f(t)e⁻ⁱωt dt

Bayes' theorem: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A) / P(B)

Stokes' theorem: ∮ F · dr = ∬ (∇ × F) · dS

The Euler-Lagrange equation: ∂L/∂q − d/dt(∂L/∂q̇) = 0

Matrix determinant: det(A) = ∑σ ∈ Sₙ (sgn(σ) · ∏ᵢ₌₁ⁿ aᵢ,σᵢ)

The logistic map: xₙ₊₁ = r · xₙ(1 − xₙ)

Entropy: S = −∑ᵢ pᵢ ln(pᵢ)
